scope: Frozen v0.8 smoke scenario conformance catalog. Every scenario supplies ALL semantic values (timestamps, IDs, keys, digest seeds, visibility/authorization/checkpoint/provenance facts) as explicit inputs. The catalog contains NO candidate-generated expected outputs, no FIXED_* constants, no counter generators, and no module-level signer key. Expected results are derived from governing contracts and schemas only.

validation_rules.scenario_count_must_be_exactly_20: The catalog must contain exactly 20 scenarios; no more, no less.
validation_rules.scenario_ids_must_be_unique: Every scenario_id must appear exactly once.
validation_rules.pipeline_must_be_non_empty: Every scenario's pipeline must have at least one step.
validation_rules.dependencies_must_reference_defined_scen: Every dependency must reference a scenario_id defined in this catalog.
validation_rules.no_self_dependency: A scenario must not list itself as a dependency.
validation_rules.acyclic_dependencies: The dependency graph must be acyclic.
validation_rules.all_semantic_values_in_inputs: Every semantic value (timestamps, IDs, keys, digests, visibility facts) must be in scenario inputs.
validation_rules.dispatch_table_complete: Every catalog pipeline entry must map to exactly one real production callable in the dispatch table.
